name: Alpaca wool scarf
about: A soft scarf made from Peruvian alpaca fiber, a traditional material of the Andes that Lima's shops sell widely.
tip: Check that the label says 100% alpaca fiber.

name: Peruvian cacao
about: Chocolate made from cacao grown in Peru, a country known for its many cacao varieties.
tip: Choose the origin and cocoa percentage that suits your taste.

name: Pisco
about: Peru's national grape brandy, used in the famous Pisco Sour cocktail.
tip: Buy at a supermarket or the airport duty-free shop.
